title: High Meadow Stables
specs: Over 20 miles of scenic trails adjacent to the ranch
Three arenas (two outdoor, one indoor) and other horse facilities
Updated health report and Coggins test required for horses before arrival
Bring any grains or supplements your horse may need
includes: Hay (Coastal) and water for boarded horses
Use of hot walker, round pen, and outdoor arena for boarded horses
Feeding twice a day (hay, grains, water) for boarded horses
blurb: Guests can board horses overnight with full care and access to arenas and trails. The ranch offers daily arena use for riders bringing their own horses and trailer parking. Trail riding is available on over 20 miles of scenic trails adjacent to the ranch.
extraNote: Visitors must ride safely and be considerate of others in shared arena and facilities · High Meadow Stables ranch
